title: Official Codex plugin build surface
key_findings: Codex plugins use .codex-plugin/plugin.json as the required entry point.
Repo and personal marketplaces live at .agents/plugins/marketplace.json and point to local plugin folders with ./-prefixed source.path values.
The documented portable plugin surface is skills, optional .mcp.json, optional .app.json, and optional assets.
Manifest paths should stay relative to the plugin root and start with ./.
recommended_actions: Add .codex-plugin/plugin.json to each skill-bearing plugin folder.
Create a repo-scoped .agents/plugins/marketplace.json so the repo is installable in Codex without manual re-entry.
Use curated Codex-facing skill trees only when needed to avoid leaking host-specific Claude behavior into the Codex surface.
